post_text_html:
If your listings for Nocco are well targetted to the Amazon persona, what happened with Barebells Vitamin Well Group?

I love Noccos, I have practiced Crossfit for many many years and they have always been there, present, to fuel my workouts in comps and anything else.

Then I thought, Barebells is part of the same company as Nocco, so why don't I feel part of their troupe?

I don't know if it's the minimalistic approach to creative, but something is off.

Since I like to play with these things, I decided to give this a go this afternoon with NO product pictures, studio quality setup or anything like that.

These are some of my attempts at keeping your brand within the minimalistic zone but better suited to Amazon listings.
